LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: A single public arcade score entry in the global TUREK highway leaderboard. Contains zero PII.

playerName.description: Public arcade nickname displayed on the global leaderboard.

score.description: Total final score achieved during the run (0 to 100000).

level.description: Highest level reached during the run (1 to 5).

ambulancesHit.description: Total bonus ambulances hit during the run (0 to 10000).

createdAt.description: Server-assigned Firestore timestamp recording when the score was submitted.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Global public arcade leaderboard collection. Append-only (create + bounded read/list); updates and deletes are strictly forbidden.
